status_note: Reproduces on 30.30.0, the latest release; main (b99f5d58b1, 2026-11-07) has no `EXPORT_STATE` in the DuckDB dialect or the parser, read in the source. No upstream issue found.
title: DuckDB: `agg(x) EXPORT_STATE` parses as the column alias `EXPORT_STATE`
summary: DuckDB's `agg(x) EXPORT_STATE` modifier parses as the column alias `EXPORT_STATE` of the aggregate's value.
repro: `sqlglot.parse_one("SELECT sum(i) EXPORT_STATE FROM t", read="duckdb")` gives `Alias(this=Sum(i), alias=EXPORT_STATE)`; DuckDB returns the aggregate's state (a struct), not its value.
handling: The lift refuses an unquoted alias named EXPORT_STATE (`sql_lift._base._check_export_state`).

checked.note: triage: repro run on 30.30.0; main read; tobymao/sqlglot searched
